clauses.anchor: after Primary Objective section, before Agent Operating Contract
clauses.text: Choose by the requested outcome, not merely the number of pasted inputs. Use SuperCharge to strengthen the current artifact, including comparisons among its candidate versions, with the existing selected modules and independent reviews. Use engos-reconciliation-converge when the deliverable is a source-attributed reconciliation of materially conflicting inputs into one recommendation. Use engos-optimization-auto-research when the user asks for measured behavioral benefit against a baseline. These are separate jobs, not a mandatory chain; naming a companion neither invokes it nor expands authority. Preserve explicit module choices, terminal controls and all existing output contracts.

clauses.anchor: after Primary Objective section, before Agent Operating Contract
clauses.text: Keep each material retained claim, conflict and muted idea attributable to its supplied source: use the actual source identity and available revision, date, section or locator, and mark unavailable provenance explicitly. Preserve disagreement rather than inventing a consensus or missing preference. Multiple variants of one artifact may still be hardened with engos-meta-supercharge; choose Converge when source-attributed reconciliation is the requested work product. A request to establish measured behavioral superiority belongs to engos-optimization-auto-research with a baseline and bounded evaluation. Do not invoke either companion automatically. The existing recommendation review remains required for substantial authored proposals.

clauses.anchor: append a Job Selection Examples subsection; preserve existing examples and terminal examples-only behavior
clauses.text: One artifact: "supercharge /simple /invert harden this rollout plan while preserving its approval boundaries" returns an improved plan and independent findings. Conflicting sources: "Use engos-reconciliation-converge to compare these two dated proposals, attribute the conflicts and recommend one" returns a source-linked decision with rejected ideas. Measured benefit: "Use engos-optimization-auto-research to compare these prompts against this frozen baseline and regression set within this budget" returns observed results or an explicit blocked/inconclusive state. These examples select separate jobs; do not execute them or chain the capabilities when listing examples.

clauses.anchor: append Source Conflict Example Resource subsection
clauses.text: For a worked source-attribution example, load route source-conflict from resources/resource-map.json and read resources/examples/source-conflict.md. Resolve these paths from the active skill resource root; obtain the complete example before claiming it was used. This optional example does not replace the domain workflow or independent recommendation review, and a missing example does not authorize inventing source evidence.

The three jobs remain separate: engos-design-shaping conducts a workshop or resumes its recorded stages; engos-audit-pitch-review can assess a finished pitch directly; engos-quality-shaping-gate owns current transition predicates, score anchors and receipts. A finished-pitch assessment does not create a workshop history. For this dependency map, load the stage-policy route and read resources/references/stage-policy-dependencies.md; for an actual gate, resolve the gate owner and read its complete applicable resources through the existing routing contract. This reference does not copy or supersede gate policy.

clauses.anchor: append to Guided Shaping Entry and Review Precedence
clauses.text: For a direct finished-pitch review, identify which supplied artifacts were actually assessed and explicitly report unavailable Intake, Framed and Research history as unassessed prerequisites. Do not mint historical receipts, require the user to retroactively stage a workshop just to obtain an assessment, or claim a G0–G4 transition from the standalone score. Keep the existing standalone rubric, artifact-completeness checks and output format; in full shaping mode the current gate owner and its applicable policy still take precedence. A recommendation that content is ready to bet is not the human betting decision, completed delivery, implementation authority or a request to start a goal. Even after human acceptance, a separate build session starts at specification only for the accepted handover scope and separately authorized build work.

clauses.anchor: append Standalone Pitch Example Resource subsection
clauses.text: For a worked finished-pitch example, load route standalone-pitch from resources/resource-map.json and read resources/examples/standalone-pitch.md from this skill bundle. Read the complete selected example before claiming it was used. The example illustrates coverage reporting; it never supplies missing facts, human decisions or receipts for the actual pitch.

clauses.anchor: after existing Invocation Hints explanatory paragraph
clauses.text: Use engos-design-plan-implementation for an ordinary dependency-aware implementation plan and task contracts. This existing engos-design-plan-to-goal skill is the compiler when a bounded long-running goal packet is explicitly wanted: it researches, drafts, materializes where permitted, lints, seals and rechecks the goal/specification/verifier bundle under all contracts below. It does not become the implementation worker or delivery controller. Compiling or sealing a packet is not a request to create or start a running goal; runtime actions require the user's separate explicit request. engos-orchestration-batman remains a separately invoked controller-owned delivery protocol. No alias, rename or automatic hop between these jobs is implied.

clauses.anchor: after Companion Contract final paragraph, before Tool Boundaries
clauses.text: Ordinary planning and goal-packet compilation do not activate Batman. engos-design-plan-implementation owns ordinary plans; engos-design-plan-to-goal may compile a separately requested bounded packet and verifier. Neither is a Batman alias or a direct-worker replacement for this controller. When this protocol is explicitly requested, retain every stage, gate, companion-resolution rule, independent role, current plan_generation, task/owner identity and controller-owned evidence/landing check below. A compiled packet neither satisfies those gates nor grants runtime or landing authority.
